content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). If the situation is less critical, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. While taking this medication, it is essential to undergo regular laboratory and medical tests, such as monitoring viral load, T-cell counts, liver function, cholesterol/triglyceride levels, and blood sugar levels. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. It is crucial not to miss doses of this medication. If you forget to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if more than four hours have passed since the missed dose, skip it and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Store the tablets at room temperature, away from light and moisture. The suspension can be stored at room temperature or in the refrigerator. Refrigeration may enhance the taste of the suspension, but do not freeze it. Avoid storing the medication in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in September 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for you. Always seek advice from your healthcare professional for complete and individualized information about this product and your health needs.
